name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: 0.0.28 fixed the 'Cannot deserialize unknown type' reconciliation crash reactively - only once this plugin's own background sync happened to hit it. That left a window, several seconds wide, where any other Jellyfin code path enumerating the same folder first (the web UI, a native library scan, another plugin) could still hit the same crash outside this plugin's control. The purge now runs eagerly at plugin startup, synchronously, before that window opens - so legacy items left over from 0.0.22-0.0.24 are gone before anything else gets a chance to touch them.
